links.outcome: Guideline concordance accuracy under injected semantic and lexical input noise, versus rule-based baseline
links.effect: LLM-RAG kept 97.00% guideline concordance accuracy under 30% semantic and 15% lexical noise; rule-based baseline fell to 10.00%. Critical violation rate 1.50%.
links.quote: The proposed LLM-RAG middleware demonstrated exceptional robustness,maintaining a Guideline Concordance Accuracy (\((ACC_{gc})\)) of 97.00%under high-dimensional noise, whereas the traditional rule-basedbaseline collapsed to 10.00%.

unlisted_practices: Local edge deployment of a quantized LLM on a CPU-only terminal to keep data on-premises
Schema-enforced structured output (Pydantic) with automated self-reflection retries

screen.reason: Evaluates an edge LLM system with output safety guardrails (Pydantic schema constraints and self-reflection retry mechanisms) on a noisy synthetic coagulation test benchmark.
